table.retrieve:
SELECT
	SaleType = 1,
	itemname =max(item.remarks),
	/*itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end, */
	users.username, 
	salecat=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	dbo.saledetail.gcode, 
	cashreceived=max(dbo.saleledger.cashreceived),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	bonusqty=sum(saledetail.bonusqty),
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
	gstperc=saledetail.gstperc,
	unitsalestax=saledetail.unitsalestax,
	invgstperc=saleledger.invgstperc1,
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(saleledger.machinename),
	reprintcounter=max(dbo.saleledger.reprintingcounter),
	SrBufferInvCode=dbo.saleledger.SRBufferInvCode,
	InvTotal = dbo.saleledger.InvTotal
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,   
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item,
	Users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.srbufferinvcode,
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks, 
	saleledger.invgstperc1,
	saledetail.icode,
	/*saledetail.rowgroup,  */
	saledetail.saleprice,
	saledetail.discperc,
	saledetail.unitsalestax,
	saledetail.gstperc,
	saledetail.itemflatdisc,  
	saledetail.gcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.InvTotal,
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.customicode,
	users.username
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	SaleType = 2,
	itemname =max(item.remarks),
	/*itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end, */
	users.username, 
	salecat=max(srbufferledger.srcatcode),
	srbufferledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.srbufferledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=srbufferledger.custcode),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.date,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.discperc,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.salestax,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.custcode,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.remarks,   
	dbo.srbufferdetail.icode,   
	dbo.srbufferdetail.gcode, 
	cashreceived=max(dbo.saleledger.cashreceived),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.srbufferdetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = - sum(srbufferdetail.looseqty), 
	bonusqty=- sum(srbufferdetail.bonusqty),
	packqty   = 0.000, 
	packunits = max(srbufferdetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(srbufferdetail.srprice), 
	rate      = max(srbufferdetail.srprice),
	salestax  = max(srbufferdetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(srbufferdetail.discperc), 
	gstperc=srbufferdetail.gstperc,
	unitsalestax=srbufferdetail.unitsalestax,
	invgstperc=srbufferledger.invgstperc1,
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = 0.00,
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(srbufferledger.machinename),
	reprintcounter=0,
	SrBufferInvCode=dbo.srbufferledger.SRBufferInvCode,
	InvTotal = dbo.srbufferledger.InvTotal
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,
	dbo.srbufferledger,   
	dbo.srbufferdetail,  
	item,
	Users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.srbufferinvcode = dbo.srbufferLedger.srbufferinvcode ) AND
	( dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode = dbo.srbufferdetail.srbufferinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.srbufferLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( dbo.srbufferdetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode,
	dbo.srbufferledger.saleinvcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	srbufferledger.date, 
	srbufferledger.custcode, 
	srbufferledger.discperc, 
	srbufferledger.flatdisc, 
	srbufferledger.misccharges, 
	srbufferledger.headerno,
	srbufferledger.salestax, 
	srbufferledger.invgstperc1,
	srbufferledger.remarks, 
	srbufferdetail.icode,
	srbufferdetail.gcode, 
	srbufferdetail.unitsalestax,
	srbufferdetail.gstperc,
	dbo.srbufferledger.InvTotal,
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.customicode,
	users.username
ORDER BY 
	SaleType,
	ID

objects.name: t_4
objects.visible: 1	if( Sum(saletype for all distinct saletype )=1, 0,1)

objects.name: t_16
objects.text: if(Round(Sum (if(saletype=1, 1, -1) *  invtotal for all distinct saletype ), 0) < 0, 'Cash Paid:', 'Cash Received:')

objects.name: compute_8
objects.visible: 1	if( Sum(saletype for all distinct saletype )=1, 0,1)
objects.expression: Round(Sum (if(saletype=1, 1, -1) *  invtotal for all distinct saletype ), 0)

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: if(Round(Sum (if(saletype=1, 1, -1) *  invtotal for all distinct saletype ), 0) < 0, cashreceived + Round(Sum (if(saletype=1, 1, -1) *  invtotal for all distinct saletype ), 0), cashreceived - Round(Sum (if(saletype=1, 1, -1) *  invtotal for all distinct saletype ), 0))

objects.name: compute_13
objects.expression: round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) +(  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice -  looseqty *  itemflatdisc )  *  ( 1 -  (   saledetail_discperc  * .01 )  )

objects.name: t_10
objects.visible: 1	IF((Sum (  c_amount for group 1)  * (saleledger_discperc  * .01)) + saleledger_flatdisc - saleledger_misccharges<>0,1,0)

objects.name: t_7
objects.visible: 1	if(Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2), 0)<>0,1,0)

objects.name: c_invdiscount
objects.visible: 1	IF((Sum (  c_amount for group 1)  * (saleledger_discperc  * .01)) + saleledger_flatdisc - saleledger_misccharges<>0,1,0)

objects.name: compute_12
objects.visible: 1	if(Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2), 0)<>0,1,0)
objects.expression: Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2), 0)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)+Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2), 0)
